overview: Landmark decision on full and rigorous Party self-governance released; Yellow River governance begins a new chapter after 80 years; A-shares receive policy tailwinds, crypto market swings wildly, Middle East tensions persist.

articles.title: Central Committee Issues Decision on Sustained Full and Strict Party Self-Governance
articles.summary: The CPC Central Committee has issued a decision on major issues concerning the sustained advancement of full and strict Party self-governance, laying out a systematic plan.
articles.detail: The decision sets out arrangements on major issues related to sustaining full and strict Party self-governance. Expert commentary notes that the Fifth Plenum demonstrates the Communist Party of China's confidence and resolve in enforcing strict Party discipline.
articles.impact: Provides institutional guidance for deeper advances in Party conduct, clean governance and anti-corruption work, further consolidating the Party's governing foundation.

articles.title: Xi Jinping Delivers Explanation on Party Self-Governance Decision
articles.summary: Xi Jinping gave an explanation on the drafting of the CPC Central Committee Decision on Major Issues Concerning Sustained Full and Strict Party Self-Governance.
articles.detail: The explanation elaborated on the background and key content of the decision, helping Party members and officials accurately understand the document's spirit.
articles.impact: Helps unify thinking across the Party and deepen understanding and implementation of the full and strict Party self-governance agenda.

articles.title: Turning the Yellow River into a River of Well-Being for the People
articles.summary: Marking 80 years of the Party leading the people in harnessing the Yellow River, a call was made to truly make the river a source of happiness for the people.
articles.detail: The article reviews 80 years of experience in Party-led Yellow River governance and sets direction for ecological protection and high-quality development of the Yellow River Basin.
articles.impact: Bodes well for basin ecological protection, flood control and sediment reduction, and high-quality development in regions along the river.

articles.title: Batch of New Regulations Take Effect from November
articles.summary: Multiple new rules formally take effect from November, covering a range of areas in public welfare and social governance.
articles.detail: The new regulations roll out from November 1, affecting businesses in relevant sectors and residents' daily behavior.
articles.impact: Brings new compliance guidance for corporate operations and everyday public life.

articles.title: CCTV Exposes Wide Gap Between Cost and Price of Pain-Relief Honey Pills
articles.summary: CCTV revealed that pain-relief honey pills priced at 2,388 yuan cost only 40 yuan to produce, while a franchisee filed a real-name report alleging banned substances in the product.
articles.detail: The report disclosed a huge gap between the product's cost and retail price, with a franchisee formally reporting banned ingredients, drawing attention to health supplement products.
articles.impact: Could spur stronger regulation of the health supplement and traditional Chinese medicine consumer markets, along with greater consumer rights awareness.

articles.title: Saudi-Led Coalition Strikes Houthi Targets in Precision Strikes
articles.summary: The Saudi-led multinational coalition says it carried out precision military strikes on November 1, destroying targets linked to Yemen's Houthi forces.
articles.detail: A coalition spokesperson said precision strikes were carried out in the morning to destroy Houthi targets. The coalition also said it intercepted and destroyed drones and ballistic missiles fired by the Houthis toward southern regions. A missile struck near a government military facility in Yemen's Aden the same day.
articles.impact: Security risks in the Red Sea and the Gulf are rising, potentially affecting expectations for international shipping and energy supplies.

articles.title: Iran Foreign Minister Says Tehran Prepared for Both Defense and Diplomacy
articles.summary: Iran's foreign minister says Tehran is prepared on both the defense and diplomatic fronts, and hopes the US will remain rational.
articles.detail: Iran's foreign minister said the choice of path depends on whether the US acts rationally; Iran is conducting indirect negotiations via Qatar but has held no direct talks with the United States. Iran's president the same day called for designing mechanisms to deliver goods to impoverished regions at more appropriate prices.
articles.impact: Diplomatic room for resolving regional tensions remains open, though near-term market sentiment stays cautious.

articles.title: Ukraine Says Russian Strike on Kyiv Energy Infrastructure Cuts Water Supply
articles.summary: Ukraine says Russia struck Kyiv's energy infrastructure, triggering water supply disruptions and outages across parts of the city.
articles.detail: Kyiv's city military administration reported that a water supply facility lost power due to the strike, leaving multiple areas of the city facing water shutoffs.
articles.impact: With winter approaching, damage to energy infrastructure will intensify living and humanitarian pressures.

articles.title: France Hits Third Consecutive Weekend of Nationwide Protests
articles.summary: Nationwide protests erupted in France for a third consecutive weekend, with riot police charging crowds multiple times to disperse them.
articles.detail: Protests continued across multiple parts of the country, with riot police launching repeated charges to disperse rioters.
articles.impact: Social unrest could weigh on European consumer and investment confidence and add pressure to policy debates.

articles.title: US Air Force Refuelers Gather Again in Israel
articles.summary: A large number of US Air Force aerial refueling tankers have assembled again at Ramon Airport in the southern Israeli city of Eilat.
articles.detail: Photos taken at Ramon Airport in Eilat, southern Israel, show a large concentration of aerial refueling tankers.
articles.impact: The signal of regional military deployment is clear, raising uncertainty in the Middle East security situation.

articles.title: China's A-Shares Get Boost as Regulators Set to Hold Policy Symposium
articles.summary: Financial regulators will convene a symposium, fueling expectations of policy support for the A-share market.
articles.detail: Markets are watching for policy signals from the regulatory symposium, lifting sentiment among A-share investors.
articles.impact: Helps stabilize market expectations and improve confidence in investor sentiment and market liquidity.

articles.title: Chinese Export Firms Shift Overseas Strategy from Selling Products to Building Brands
articles.summary: Chinese foreign trade companies are expanding abroad with greater confidence, transitioning from product exports to exporting brands and services.
articles.detail: Reports show trade firms are accelerating their push into overseas branding and services, strengthening competitiveness and pricing power.
articles.impact: Bodes well for supply chains tied to cross-border e-commerce, brand expansion and services trade.

articles.title: Autumn Tourism Boom Injects Fresh Momentum into Consumption
articles.summary: Commentary notes that the autumn sightseeing economy is in full swing, becoming a key source of fresh economic vitality.
articles.detail: Autumn culture and travel spending continues to heat up, driving related sectors including dining, lodging and transportation.
articles.impact: Further unlocks the potential of culture and travel consumption, supporting the recovery of domestic demand.

articles.title: APEC China Year: High-Standard Opening Up Powers Asia-Pacific Cooperation
articles.summary: Experts debate how China's high-standard opening up can empower regional cooperation in the Asia-Pacific.
articles.detail: Against the backdrop of the APEC China Year, stakeholders are discussing opening up, cooperation and regional economic integration.
articles.impact: Helps strengthen Asia-Pacific supply chain coordination and benefits cross-border trade and investment.

articles.title: Authoritative Data Roundup: China in Focus (October 25–31)
articles.summary: Authoritative data reviews last week's economic performance and key livelihood trends in China.
articles.detail: The data roundup compiles key economic and social indicators from October 25 to October 31.
articles.impact: Provides a data reference for tracking economic performance and policy outcomes.

articles.title: Binance Sees Over $3.5 Billion in Net Outflows After Hack
articles.summary: Binance recorded over $3.5 billion in net outflows following the theft of $6.3 billion in crypto assets, with the market gradually stabilizing.
articles.detail: DefiLlama data shows Binance recorded over $3.5 billion in net outflows on Sunday; the exchange said it processed $4.649 billion in withdrawals and $1.01 billion in deposits on November 1, resulting in net outflows of about $3.64 billion, or 2.1% of total assets under management. Withdrawal volumes have since declined and stabilized, with market conditions steady.
articles.impact: In the short term, it pressures crypto market confidence and stablecoin liquidity; in the long term, it tests the exchange's risk controls and compensation capacity.

articles.title: Global Nuclear Reactors Under Construction Rise to 79
articles.summary: The number of nuclear reactors under construction worldwide has climbed to 79, with AI demand driving nuclear energy growth.
articles.detail: Market reports indicate that surging AI computing demand has become a key driver of accelerated nuclear power construction globally.
articles.impact: Positive for nuclear equipment, nuclear fuel, and related power infrastructure supply chains.

articles.title: Trump: If Democrats Win Majority, He May Have to Become 'Veto Man'
articles.summary: Trump said that if Democrats win a majority in the midterm elections, he may have to play the role of 'veto man.'
articles.detail: Trump also said he might reach a deal with Democrats at some point, setting the tone for post-midterm political maneuvering.
articles.impact: US midterm election outcomes will shape fiscal and regulatory policy direction, influencing risk appetite across global capital markets.

articles.title: Manned Lunar Mission Adopts Dual-Launch Lunar-Orbit Rendezvous Plan
articles.summary: China's manned lunar exploration program has finalized a plan involving two launches and a lunar-orbit docking.
articles.detail: The plan clarifies the program's implementation roadmap, providing an overall design basis for subsequent development and mission progression.
articles.impact: Accelerates the development of technologies and supply chains in space launch vehicles, rendezvous and docking, and deep-space exploration.

articles.title: Leading Technology Awards Paint Global Picture of Digital and Intelligent Innovation
articles.summary: The Leading Technology Awards were announced at the Wuzhen Internet Conference, showcasing global achievements in digital and intelligent innovation.
articles.detail: Winning projects span frontier digital technology fields, reflecting the vibrancy of global tech innovation.
articles.impact: Boosts the commercialization of digital technologies and drives industrial digital and intelligent upgrading.

articles.title: Open Source Ecosystem Becomes the Strongest Voice in Tech Development
articles.summary: Commentary notes that openness brings vitality, with open source emerging as the strongest force driving technology development.
articles.detail: The open-source model promotes technology sharing and collaborative innovation, accelerating the flourishing of industrial ecosystems.
articles.impact: Helps lower barriers to innovation and accelerates the buildout of domestic software and hardware ecosystems.

articles.title: Sun Yingsha beats Wang Yidi 4-3 to reach final
articles.summary: Sun Yingsha defeated Wang Yidi 4-3 to book her place in the final.
articles.detail: The Chinese national team players battled through seven grueling games before a winner emerged, securing a spot in the final.
articles.impact: Intense competition within China's women's singles squad continues to drive growing interest in the tournament.

articles.title: Scoliosis becoming a growing problem among Chinese students
articles.summary: Reports say scoliosis is affecting a large number of Chinese students, taking a toll on their physical and mental health.
articles.detail: The discussion centers on posture and health issues among students and their underlying causes.
articles.impact: Encourages schools, families and the medical sector to jointly address posture and health management among young people.

articles.title: Anti-aging effects of stem cell infusions spark debate
articles.summary: Whether stem cell infusions costing hundreds of thousands of yuan per shot can truly slow aging is drawing scrutiny.
articles.detail: Coverage examines the actual efficacy of stem cell anti-aging treatments alongside the phenomenon of high-price marketing.
articles.impact: Could spur tighter regulation of the anti-aging consumer market and stronger public science education.

articles.title: Flu season hits: drug choice within 48 hours sparks debate
articles.summary: How to choose medication within the first 48 hours of catching the flu has become a topic of public concern.
articles.detail: The article discusses timing and selection of flu medication during the peak season.
articles.impact: Raises public awareness of flu prevention and treatment, boosting demand for related drugs and vaccines.
